story-context.title: Eval Diff + Statistics Tooling
story-context.overview: Add the comparison and statistical decision layer to the Form AI eval harness. Story 6.4.3c consumes run artifacts from 6.4.3a/6.4.2 and judge summaries from 6.4.3b, then emits Markdown/CSV/JSON diff reports with structural blockers, advisory deltas, Welch/Fisher statistics, effect sizes, and rerun recommendations.

critical-objectives.item: Do not mutate prompts or run hypothesis sweeps in this story.
Keep schema_valid regressions and boundary violations as blocking outcomes.
Keep all other deltas advisory unless future policy changes.
Make outputs useful for Story 6.4.4 prompt shrink decisions.
Avoid new heavyweight dependencies unless justified before implementation.

constraints.item: Do NOT change backend/modules/form_ai prompt content.
Do NOT implement CI PR-comment automation; document it as future work.
Do NOT call live LLMs or judges in tests.
Do NOT add SciPy or other dependencies without pausing for approval.
